description: Buddy Phase 34 — Critical Path Testing & Hardening. execution.py (2860 lines) and continuous.py (1600 lines) have zero test coverage despite being the core trading paths. This phase adds mock-based tests for execution gates, position sizing, exit classification, and journal integrity. Also adds safety guards for division-by-zero edge cases in sizing calculations. DIRECTIVE: NEVER STOP. DONT ASK. ONLY ASK WHEN DESTRUCTIVE.

userStories.title: Unit tests for ExecutionManager gate logic
userStories.description: can_trade(), _check_portfolio_risk_limit(), _check_correlation_exposure(), _check_spread_conditions() have no tests. Create mock-based tests covering pass/fail paths.
userStories.notes: PASS — 9 tests: can_trade daily limit (4), portfolio risk limit (3), correlation exposure (2). All pass.

userStories.title: Unit tests for ATR-based SL/TP calculation
userStories.description: _calculate_base_tp_pips has complex ATR logic with clamping and high probability bonus. No tests exist.
userStories.notes: PASS — 7 tests: normal ATR calc, min/max clamping, high-prob bonus, zero ATR/pip fallback. All pass.

userStories.title: Unit tests for exit reason classification
userStories.description: _determine_exit_reason classifies trade closures but has no tests. Critical for RL feedback accuracy.
userStories.notes: PASS — 9 tests: tp_hit, sl_hit, breakeven_stop, trailing_stop (long+short), timeout, manual_close, missing prices. All pass.

userStories.title: Unit tests for journal append and file locking
userStories.description: _append_journal_entry writes to trade_journal_rl.json with file locking (Phase 32 US-193). No tests for integrity.
acceptanceCriteria: Test journal entry creation with all required fields
userStories.notes: PASS — 4 tests: required fields check, corrupt recovery, empty recovery, append preservation. All pass.

userStories.title: Guard division-by-zero in position sizing calculations
userStories.description: _fallback_lots and _calculate_lots_from_sizer divide by sl_pips and pip_value. Edge case: sl_pips=0 or pip_value=0 could cause ZeroDivisionError.
acceptanceCriteria: Guard all division operations in sizing methods against zero divisors
Return minimum lot size when division would be zero
userStories.notes: PASS — sl_pips and tp_pips guarded with max(min_value, 1.0) after risk manager adjustment in calculate_position_size. Warning logged on trigger.

userStories.title: Unit tests for position sizing fallback and regime-aware sizing
userStories.description: calculate_position_size and calculate_regime_aware_position_size have complex logic with multiple fallback paths. No test coverage.
userStories.notes: PASS — 5 tests: fallback lots range, zero ATR handling, zero equity, regime-aware sizing, PIP_VALUES positivity. All pass.
